name: Stanley Kubrick
hook: The perfectionist auteur behind 2001, A Clockwork Orange, The Shining and Dr. Strangelove.

facts.label: 2001: A Space Odyssey
facts.statement: 2001: A Space Odyssey was inspired by Arthur C. Clarke's story "The Sentinel" and set to The Blue Danube and Thus Spoke Zarathustra.

facts.label: A Clockwork Orange
facts.statement: A Clockwork Orange (1971) adapted Anthony Burgess's novel; Kubrick himself pulled it from British release fearing copycat violence.

facts.label: Dr. Strangelove
facts.statement: Dr. Strangelove (1964) turned Peter George's novel Red Alert into a nuclear black comedy; Slim Pickens rides the bomb.

facts.label: The Shining
facts.statement: The Shining (1980) adapts Stephen King's novel; Shelley Duvall's scene holds the record at 127 takes, and Danny sees twin girls.

facts.label: Full Metal Jacket
facts.statement: Full Metal Jacket (1987) follows Marines from basic training to Vietnam, adapted from Gustav Hasford's The Short-Timers.

facts.label: Eyes Wide Shut
facts.statement: Eyes Wide Shut (1999), his final film, stars Tom Cruise and Nicole Kidman and adapts Schnitzler's Traumnovelle.

facts.label: Paths of Glory
facts.statement: Paths of Glory (1957) is a WWI film about French soldiers accused of cowardice.
